Definition: to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh
BiblicalUsage: 1) to drive, lead, guide, conduct; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to drive, lead on, drive away, drive off; 1a2) to behave itself (fig.) (of heart); 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to drive away, lead off; 1b2) to lead on, guide, guide on; 1b3) to cause to drive; 2) (Piel) to moan, lament
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
